column2: my uncle grabbed my little cousin and shoved her face down in the creek, she came up choking
he kept dunking me in the bath and holding me down, i finally got out and my lungs burn
please my brother-in-law is holding my sister's head in the fish pond and she stopped kicking
she pushed me into the lake off the dock and held my head down until i swallowed water
tonight my roommate's boyfriend attempted to drown me in the kitchen sink
he forced me under the water in the hotel pool and kept me there
my mom's husband put my head in the toilet bowl and flushed and held it, i'm shaking and coughing
two kids held a younger boy under the water at the swim hole, he's gray and not answering
my partner keeps trying to drown me whenever i take a bath, i'm locked in the bedroom now
a guy at the beach held my girlfriend under a wave on purpose and she's throwing up salt water
my manager grabbed me by the hair and smashed my face into the desk, my teeth are loose and there's blood
some guy on the train punched me out of nowhere, i think my cheekbone is broken
my cousin beat my aunt with a broom handle and her arm looks deformed and swollen
the customer threw a coffee mug at my head and now i've got a gash and feel dizzy
a man kicked my dad in the ribs outside the bar, he can barely breathe
i was jumped leaving work and there's blood all over my shirt from my nose
my coworker body slammed me into the pallet rack, i can't move my shoulder
my girlfriend hit me with a frying pan and my ear is bleeding
someone sucker punched my son at the game and he's confused and slurring
my supervisor twisted my arm behind my back until something popped, it's swelling fast
someone doused our front steps with gas and i can hear a lighter clicking outside
my ex keeps texting that he'll torch the place with me in it, and his truck just pulled up with gas cans
a stranger threw something burning through our kitchen window and the curtains are smoking
my stepson splashed lighter fluid all over the hallway and is holding matches
there's a guy pouring fuel along the side of our trailer right now
my neighbor lit a trash pile against our wooden fence on purpose and it's spreading toward the house
somebody is trying to set our car on fire in the driveway, we're inside
my husband swears he will set the house ablaze with the kids inside and he's got the gas can
someone stuffed a flaming rag in our mailbox and ran
my brother soaked his girlfriend's bedroom door in gasoline and is yelling that he'll light it
my 9 year old never showed up at soccer practice and the coach hasn't seen her
we lost our son at the county fair two hours ago, the deputies are helping look
my daughter hasn't come back from walking the dog and the dog came home alone
our 4 year old is gone from the backyard and the gate is open, we're searching the street
my 13 year old ran away last night and her phone is off, the police have a report
my twins didn't get off the school bus and the driver says they were never on it
i can't find my son at the beach, he's 7 and wearing a red swimsuit, lifeguards are looking
my stepdaughter went missing after school, we called everyone
no one has seen my grandson since he left the park this afternoon
our baby isn't in her crib and the back door is unlocked
my grandfather with alzheimer's left the house barefoot, no one can find him
my mom has dementia and wandered away from the care home this morning
my brother is autistic and doesn't talk, he walked away from us at the stadium
my 79 year old dad drove off to the pharmacy around noon and isn't answering, he gets confused
my aunt with severe memory loss got on a bus alone and nobody knows where she went
my husband has type 1 diabetes, left without his insulin and hasn't come back since last night
my sister is schizophrenic, off her meds, and nobody has heard from her since sunday
my grandma slipped out of the house at 2am, she has dementia and it's raining
my neighbor's elderly father with alzheimer's is missing and the police are searching the woods behind us
my son is 30 with down syndrome and he didn't come home from his day program
